---
title: "About me"
---

I am an ecologist and researcher interested in understanding how biodiversity, ecological interactions and environmental change shape the dynamics of infectious diseases.

My research lies at the intersection of:

- Community Ecology
- Conservation Biology
- Disease Ecology
- Eco-evolutionary Dynamics
- Landscape Ecology
- One Health

I am particularly interested in understanding how landscape transformation affects host–parasite interactions and biodiversity, and how these ecological processes can contribute to disease emergence and spillover.

## Background

I hold a degree in Biological Sciences and a Master's and PhD in Ecology and Conservation.

My research experience combines ecological theory, biodiversity conservation, computational methods and disease ecology.

Currently, I work as a postdoctoral researcher developing approaches to understand the effects of environmental change on ecological communities and host–parasite interactions.
